tasks.short: Verify settlement data and confirm a claim follows company procedure.

steps.what: Collect claim, settlement, invoice, and payment data
Verify settlement data against authority and procedure
Investigate a settlement discrepancy or invalid claim
Record the settlement compliance finding and follow-up

tasks.design: A configured check in the {OTHER} claim record joins settlement, authority, payment, and procedure data from {ERP} and {DOCS}. It produces a discrepancy queue; the claims adjuster investigates exceptions and writes the compliance finding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff compare case, payment, and procedure data across records before they can find a meaningful discrepancy.
tasks.enabler_now: Required fields and configured limits can catch missing or inconsistent settlement data before manual investigation.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a claim is valid and a settlement is fair depends on evidence and exceptions, not just a rule match.
tasks.human_edge: The claims adjuster judges materiality, evidence quality, and whether an apparent exception is justified.

ambition.what: Review a daily queue of settlement discrepancies before payment delays grow.

tasks.altitude: The role shifts from record comparison to investigating exceptions and improving settlement controls.

reach.learn: Trace a versioned settlement record to its payment status.

evidence.claim: Configured checks can compare structured claim and payment fields before a human investigates an exception.

assumptions: The workflow starts with a proposed or completed settlement and ends with a compliance finding.
Fields are claim identifier, settlement version, amount, currency, payee identifier, authority limit, procedure code, payment status, and exception reason; claims and finance teams produce them.
Missing fields and non-matching versions route to the claims adjuster. Native claim-system controls are tested before custom checks.
Two hours per 100 baseline hours cover control changes and exception-rule review.
unknowns: The available settlement, authority, and payment fields.
The materiality threshold and escalation policy for discrepancies.
research_questions: Which rule failures are genuine errors?
How often does a data mismatch change the settlement outcome?

already_counted.description: Review configured rule results and record exception findings

incremental.description: Maintain settlement rules and investigate recurring false positives

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes many exceptions need evidence review; two focal-role upkeep hours per 100 baseline hours are deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review police, medical, and property records to assess liability.

steps.what: Request police reports, medical records, bills, and photos
Extract dates and facts from liability records

loop.input: police reports, medical records, bills, and damage material
loop.output: dated liability chronology with source locations
loop.check: claims adjuster checks dates, parties, and source references
loop.stop: stop on missing records, unclear handwriting, or contradictory accounts; request manual review
loop.why_not_simpler: Police, medical, and property evidence is unstructured and case-specific.

steps.what: Assess liability and the extent of loss
Document liability reasoning or refer contested claims

tasks.design: A {WORKFLOW} case checklist requests police, medical, bill, and property evidence and stores it in {DOCS}. A bounded extraction prepares a chronology, while the claims adjuster assesses liability and decides whether to refer a contested claim.
tasks.previous_blocker: Liability evidence arrives from several external parties in different formats and the judgement has financial and legal consequences.
tasks.enabler_now: A checklist and cited chronology reduce the assembly work without deciding liability.
tasks.still_hard: Causation, credibility, and disputed evidence require accountable human judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The claims adjuster weighs competing accounts and the real-world meaning of medical and property evidence.

ambition.what: Check the daily liability-evidence queue so missing records are requested earlier.

tasks.altitude: The claims adjuster spends more time resolving contested facts and less time transcribing records.

evidence.claim: A bounded extraction can prepare a cited chronology from unstructured records for human review.

assumptions: The workflow starts with a liability investigation and ends with a documented assessment or referral.
Fields are claim identifier, evidence type, received date, document version, party, evidence status, and referral status; the claims adjuster records them.
Medical records and police reports remain access-controlled. Missing, unreadable, or conflicting documents are reviewed manually.
Two hours per 100 baseline hours cover evidence-checklist and extraction-exception maintenance.
unknowns: Which evidence sources may be accessed through the claim record.
The rate of contested liability and required legal referral.
research_questions: How many files lack one required liability record?
Which chronology fields are most often corrected?

already_counted.description: Check the evidence chronology and request missing records

incremental.description: Maintain evidence requests and review extraction exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Most time remains in liability assessment and contested referrals; two focal-role upkeep hours per 100 baseline hours are deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate property damage and create or review damage estimates.

steps.what: Receive damage photos, repair quotes, and inspection notes
Classify visible property damage from submitted photos

loop.input: submitted property photos and damage categories
loop.output: proposed damage classification with image references
loop.check: claims adjuster compares classification to photos and inspection notes
loop.stop: stop on poor images, hidden damage, or safety concerns; request an inspection
loop.why_not_simpler: Photo evidence can be incomplete and property damage needs case-specific interpretation.

steps.what: Inspect complex property damage or verify repair scope
Create or review the property damage estimate

tasks.design: A {WORKFLOW} case record receives damage photos and repair material, then prepares a damage classification for the {OTHER} claim record. It does not replace an inspection or approve an estimate; the claims adjuster reviews the scope and estimate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Photos, quotes, and inspection notes are incomplete in different ways, while damage scope needs physical and policy judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Image classification can organise submitted photos and a record template can assemble an estimate for review.
tasks.still_hard: Hidden damage, repair quality, and the reasonableness of a quote require inspection and human judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The claims adjuster notices context not visible in a photo and tests whether a repair scope is reasonable.

ambition.what: Give claimants a clear photo and quote checklist before a property-damage review.

tasks.altitude: The role spends less time sorting images and more time on complex inspections and estimate challenges.

reach.learn: Use a consistent photo and inspection evidence record.

evidence.claim: Photo-based damage assessment exists as a capability, but needs human review for incomplete or complex damage.

assumptions: The workflow starts when photos or a repair quote arrive and ends with a reviewed property damage estimate.
Fields are claim identifier, property type, photo identifier, photo date, inspection status, quote version, estimate version, and damage category; claimants, repairers, and adjusters provide them.
Poor images or missing inspections are not estimated automatically. Native claim-system photo and estimate fields are tested first.
Two hours per 100 baseline hours cover category maintenance and image-review exceptions.
unknowns: Which property types and damage categories are in scope.
The share of claims that require on-site inspection.
research_questions: How often does photo classification change after inspection?
Which estimate fields are still re-keyed from repair quotes?

already_counted.description: Review damage classification and the prepared estimate

incremental.description: Maintain damage categories and review photo-classification exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes more poor photos and inspections; two focal-role upkeep hours per 100 baseline hours are deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interview or correspond to correct errors and investigate questionable claims.

steps.what: Identify claim errors, omissions, and questionable facts

loop.input: claim fields, correspondence, and required evidence list
loop.output: question list grouped by error, omission, or concern
loop.check: claims adjuster removes irrelevant questions and checks the claim file
loop.stop: stop when there is suspected fraud or safety risk; follow specialist escalation
loop.why_not_simpler: Questionable claims depend on missing context and free-text correspondence.

steps.what: Interview agents and claimants about claim errors
Correct verified omissions and errors in the claim
Decide whether questionable claims need investigation

tasks.design: A {WORKFLOW} checklist identifies missing claim fields and prepares a question list from the {OTHER} claim record. The claims adjuster conducts the interview, corrects verified errors, and decides whether the questionable claim needs an investigation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The facts that make a claim questionable often sit in unstructured correspondence and need a human conversation to resolve.
tasks.enabler_now: A structured gap check can prepare questions and make verified corrections easier to record.
tasks.still_hard: Credibility, explanations, and an escalation decision need accountable judgement and a respectful conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The claims adjuster asks follow-up questions, reads hesitation, and distinguishes a genuine correction from a suspicious explanation.

ambition.what: Review new questionable-claim referrals each day so evidence does not go stale.

tasks.altitude: The claims adjuster spends less time finding gaps and more time on interviews and escalation quality.

reach.learn: Document evidence and use a clear escalation threshold.

evidence.claim: A structured gap check can prepare questions from claim fields and correspondence, while human interviews resolve the facts.

assumptions: The workflow starts when an error, omission, or concern is identified and ends with a corrected record or investigation referral.
Fields are claim identifier, concern type, question version, contact attempt, response status, correction reason, and referral status; claims adjusters produce them.
Only verified facts are written to the claim record. Missing responses and suspected fraud remain in a human-managed queue.
One hour per 100 baseline hours covers maintaining gap rules and checking false alerts.
unknowns: The organisation's threshold for a questionable-claim referral.
Whether calls and correspondence may be retained in the case record.
research_questions: How many interviews lead to a correction versus an investigation referral?

already_counted.description: Review the prepared question list and corrected claim record

incremental.description: Maintain gap rules and review false questionable-claim alerts

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Most time remains in interviews and escalation decisions; one focal-role upkeep hour per 100 baseline hours is deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use prepared evidence and control queues to focus on disputed facts, settlement quality, and fair claimant conversations.
reach: Support finance with settlement-payment exception evidence.
Support investigators with clear questionable-claim referrals.
role.ambitious_version: A claims operation that finds incomplete evidence earlier while keeping liability, damage, and questionable-claim judgement with an accountable adjuster.
